sections.title: Saying you fit the requirements
sections.content: Job postings list *követelmények* (requirements) and *elvárások* (expectations). To express that a candidate fits them: *megfelel az elvárásoknak* (governs dative *-nak/-nek*) or *alkalmas a munkára* (governs sublative *-ra/-re*).

items.english: I feel that I meet the expectations.

items.spanish: Anna kiválóan alkalmas erre a feladatra.
items.english: Anna is excellently suited for this task.
I possess the necessary professional experience.

sections.content: Notice that *rendelkezik* (to possess/have at one's disposal) takes the instrumental *-val/-vel*: *tapasztalattal rendelkezem*.
